sections.h2: What should a Cutler Bay owner check first before selling?
sections.html:
Start with the Town of Cutler Bay's own records and rules, then the county's. The town's site lists Permits and Inspections, Code Compliance, Property Registration and Floodplain information, and a seller who has open work or a code case should clear it before a buyer's title search finds it.

Cutler Bay is a town in southern Miami-Dade County, divided into three residential districts under its charter. Its site also carries Hurricane Preparedness pages and a Flood Awareness link, both useful when a buyer asks about insurance and storm history.

sections.h2: What do Census figures say about housing in Cutler Bay?
sections.html:
Cutler Bay had 44,750 residents on July 1, 2025, a 1.5 percent decline from the April 2020 estimates base of 45,426. Its 9.89 square miles of land held about 4,594.4 people per square mile in 2020, and 69.7 percent of housing units are owner-occupied.

sections.h2: How does commuting and work shape the Cutler Bay market?
sections.html:
Cutler Bay residents face a mean travel time to work of 38.2 minutes, well above the 26.4 minute U.S. figure. Census also reports 66.1 percent of people 16 and older in the labor force.

  • Census records a 2020-2024 mean commute figure that is the highest figure among these local profiles.
  • Census counts 2022 retail sales of $978,112 thousand, about $22,257 per person.

Long commutes make access to major roads a selling point worth mentioning to buyers.

sections.h2: Where is the Miami-Dade Property Appraiser for Cutler Bay owners?
sections.html:
The appraiser runs a regional branch inside Cutler Bay at the South Dade Government Center, 10710 SW 211 Street, 2nd Floor, open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, phone 305-232-3810. Appointments can be booked online.

The appraiser states that it does not send tax bills or set or collect taxes, which the Miami-Dade tax collector handles. The office certified the 2026 tax roll on October 16, 2026, and the Value Adjustment Board can still change values after pending appeals. Widow and veteran disability exemptions can be filed online through its Online Exemptions tool.

sections.h2: What do deed taxes and recording cost for a Cutler Bay sale?
sections.html:
Miami-Dade charges 60 cents per $100 in documentary stamp tax plus a 45 cents per $100 surtax, and the surtax is not due on a document transferring only a single-family dwelling. The base rate is in s. 201.02, and the Department of Revenue says all parties are liable regardless of who agrees to pay.

  • The county clerk collects the tax at recording.
  • Recording charges include $5.00 for page one and $4.00 for each later page.
  • The deed needs two witnesses, and audio-video witnessing is allowed.

The Miami-Dade Clerk of Court and Comptroller offers a free alert that tells you within 24 hours if a deed or mortgage is recorded in your name.

sections.h2: How do homestead and the Save Our Homes cap affect a Cutler Bay sale?
sections.html:
A homestead owner's taxable value is held below market by the cap, and a sale resets it. The cap is the lower of 3 percent or the CPI change, and the Department of Revenue chart shows 2.7 percent for 2026.

  • Homestead takes up to $50,000 off taxable value, with the first $25,000 applying to school taxes.
  • The new owner begins at just value on the January 1 after the sale.
  • If you move to another Florida home, portability may carry over up to $500,000 of your savings, filed by March 1.

Buyers should use the appraiser's estimator before they assume your tax bill will carry over.

sections.h2: What if a Cutler Bay house has a tenant, an heir or a lender involved?
sections.html:
The timing rules differ for each. For rentals, nonpayment gives the tenant 3 days and a month-to-month tenancy ends with at least 30 days' notice. After a court judgment, the sheriff gives 24 hours' posted notice.

  • An heir may need a personal representative first. Smaller estates of $150,000 or less may use summary administration.
  • A lender's judicial sale occurs 20 to 35 days after final judgment.
  • A tax certificate holder may apply for a tax deed two years after April 1 of the year of issuance.

Ask the Miami-Dade clerk or a Florida attorney how these steps apply to your file.

sections.h2: What projects and services does the town list for residents?
sections.html:
The town's home page announces a planned Legacy Park and Municipal Complex on 16 acres in the heart of Cutler Bay, with a community park, Town Hall, Police Station and Community Center. It also lists golf cart registration, a Holiday Golf Cart Parade, an Active Adults program and a Floodplain Mitigation Plan Advisory Committee.

Those details tell a buyer the town runs its own parks, code and permit functions. Sellers can point to the Education Advisory Committee and the Schools page on the town site when buyers ask about local schools, and send them to the county for school boundary questions.

sections.h2: What does the Florida property tax calendar mean for a Cutler Bay seller?
sections.html:
Taxes follow the state calendar: assessment on January 1, exemption filing by March 1, a proposed-tax notice mailed in August, bills in November, and delinquency after April 1. A value challenge goes to the clerk within 25 days of the August notice.

Because a bill for the full year arrives in November, a house that closes in the spring or summer leaves the buyer and seller to settle the year between them. Your closing agent will prorate it, and the figures should appear on the settlement statement. Check that line before you sign, and compare it with the tax collector's online record for your folio.

sections.h2: Which senior and veteran benefits might end when a Cutler Bay owner sells?
sections.html:
These Florida benefits tie to the home, so ask the appraiser how each applies before you list.

  • An additional exemption of up to $50,000 for owners 65 and older, where a local ordinance allows it and income is within the limit.
  • A tax discount equal to the VA disability percentage for veterans 65 and older with a permanent service-connected disability.
  • A $5,000 reduction for a disabled ex-servicemember with a rating of 10 percent or more.
  • A deferral on Form DR-570, filed by March 31.

Census records 1,053 veterans in Cutler Bay and 16.9 percent of residents at 65 or older, so these programs reach many local owners.

faqs.q: What is the median home value in Cutler Bay?
faqs.a: Census QuickFacts lists $472,700 for owner-occupied housing units in Cutler Bay for 2020-2024.
The estimate for July 1, 2025 is 44,750, which is 1.5 percent lower than the April 2020 estimates base of 45,426.

faqs.q: Does the surtax apply to my Cutler Bay deed?
faqs.a: Miami-Dade's 45 cents per $100 surtax is not due on a document that transfers only a single-family dwelling. The 60 cents per $100 base tax still applies.

faqs.q: Where can I get help with an exemption?
faqs.a: The Property Appraiser of Miami-Dade County runs a branch at the South Dade Government Center in Cutler Bay and lets owners file some exemptions online.
The Miami-Dade County tax collector sends it each November, and the 4 percent early-payment discount applies when you pay in that month.
